entries.text: i will never date an aries again. my ex was an aries and i aged 4 years in 4 months
not me stuck in a 2 hour argument with a taurus over something they already know they're wrong about. never again
my ex was a gemini and i still don't know which one of them i actually dated. block, delete, move states
dated a cancer once. still getting subtweeted about it. from 2021.
i will never date a leo again, i have thanked ONE (1) person for existing today and it wasn't the leo
my ex was a virgo and he critiqued my parking, my texting, and my personality. in that order. in one sitting.
dated a libra. asked where they wanted to eat. we are still deciding. it is 2026.
i will never date a scorpio again, i broke up with mine in my head and they somehow still knew before i said it
my ex was a sagittarius. he's currently 'finding himself' in a country he can't point to on a map. we were together 6 months.
dated a capricorn who rescheduled our anniversary for a work call. never again. i deserve a whole calendar invite of love
i will never date an aquarius again, i had to text his best friend to find out if we were still together
my ex was a pisces and cried during the breakup he initiated. sir. you did this. to yourself.
